reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the changes aligning Ollama streaming requests with system-message and JSON-output configuration. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Aligns Ollama streaming requests with non-streaming behavior, addressing the missing system message reported in #322 and honoring JSON output configuration. **Changes:** - Sends the configured system message in `generateStreamOfText()` requests. - Adds `format: json` to both streaming methods when enabled. - Adds mock-based tests for configured values and their omission by default. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​Unit/​Chat/​OllamaChatTest.php` | Adds streaming request payload tests for system messages and JSON format. | | `src/​Chat/​OllamaChat.php` | Applies system messages to text streaming and JSON format to both streaming methods. |
Review effort: Balanced
